run_tracking_evaluation: run a TrackingEvaluation instance with an agent to evaluate motion tracking metrics across multiple motions
create_tracking_evaluation: create a TrackingEvaluation dataclass with motion files, environment parameters, and optional multiprocessing workers
run_async_tracking_worker: run the async tracking worker function to evaluate an agent on a batch of motion IDs
calc_metrics: calculate distance proximity, EMD, and PHC metrics comparing agent observations against tracking targets
close_tracking_evaluation: close a TrackingEvaluation instance to shut down the multiprocessing manager and free resources
